description: Main window. The opener may open only these sites, over https (the page checks too: src/lib/core/links.ts); it can't open files or folders, or show them in the file manager (orbiter's log folders are opened from Rust). Of the process plugin, only restart (after an update is installed); updates themselves go through orbiter's own commands (updates.rs), so none of the updater plugin's commands are allowed.
